meta.title: Check AI product photos before they go live
meta.desc: A Telegram bot that compares a generated product photo with the real item and shows what changed: print, colour, buttons, fit, jewelry size.

hero.kicker: For marketplace sellers on Amazon, Etsy, Wildberries, Ozon and beyond
hero.h1: Your AI product photo lies politely. The bot shows where
hero.lead: Send the generated photo and a photo of the real item. The bot finds what changed and tells you how to fix it, before a buyer files a return.
hero.cta_note: The first checks are free. Photos are deleted right after the check.

problems.h: A generator doesn't break the picture. It swaps the product

items.title: The print got simpler
items.text: Complex patterns get redrawn the model's way. Pretty on screen, different in the box.

items.title: The colour "improved"
items.text: Warmer gold, brighter fabric. The buyer sees a shade they won't receive.

items.title: A detail went missing
items.text: A button, a pocket, a stone in the pavé. Models don't count; they draw what looks plausible.

steps: Open the bot and send the generated product photo.
Send a photo of the real item; a phone snapshot is fine.
Get a list of differences and a concrete fix.

who.text: LookTwinStudio makes AI advertising photos and video for clothing and jewelry brands. For one jewelry brand our pipeline produced 11,246 photos and videos in four months, with an automatic check that the piece in each image stayed itself. The bot puts that kind of check in every seller's hands.

status.text: The bot is launching. Press /start and we'll message you as soon as checks open for everyone.

privacy.block: We keep your Telegram ID for the waitlist (up to 180 days, and no more than 30 days after paid checks launch), the number of your checks under an anonymised key for 90 days, and anonymised check codes, also for 90 days and not linked to you. Photos are deleted when the check ends. The /forget command in the bot deletes everything linked to you.
